data.detail: The document only amends the notice period for non-renewal from 60 days to 30 days and states that all other terms remain unchanged. There is no mention of any indemnity obligation, let alone a one-sided indemnity obligation without reciprocal terms. Therefore, the policy rule is not triggered.

Policy rule: Does this document contain an indemnity obligation that binds only one party, with no reciprocal obligation on the other? Answer triggered=true only if the one-sidedness is stated in the text you cite.
